## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

  The demand for cloud infrastructure for AI training and inferencing greatly exceeds supply. In

  available in Amazon, Google, Microsoft, and Oracle Cloud data centers all over the world.
  
  Pick the cloud you want to use.
  
  Get the same low price everywhere.

  **AI Models in Oracle Cloud**
  
  Google Gemini, Meta Llama, OpenAI ChatGPT, xAI Grok, and more . . .

  Unifies all your private structured and unstructured data without moving it – by using the AI Data
  Platform's Data Catalog
  
  [Get started with AI Data Catalog][24]

  An end-to-end Integrated Development Environment for building any type of AI Application – chat,
  multistep agents, transactions, workflows – on all your data
  
  [Get started with AI Data Platform Workbench][25]

  Installed in your data center from $250,000 per month

  **All OCI Services and Applications**
  
  Put the entire Oracle Cloud inside your data center. Cloud@Customer includes every Oracle
  infrastructure service and application. Your data and network traffic stay secure and private
  inside your data center and behind your firewall.
  
  **Enable AI on your Private Data**
  
  Now you can do AI inferencing and multistep reasoning on your private data while keeping that data
  private.
  
  [Learn more][27]

  [Finance and Accounting][28]

  [Marketing][32]

  [Service][34]
  
  [Learn more][35]

  Modernizes back-office operations and enables innovation

  Patients are continually monitored in transit by hospital ER doctors

  All private data unified in data catalog
* [Cloud@Customer]
  
  ### All OCI Services in 3 Racks
  
  Installed in your data center from $250,000 per month
  
  ## Cloud@Customer
  
  **All OCI Services and Applications**
  
  Put the entire Oracle Cloud inside your data center. Cloud@Customer includes every Oracle
  infrastructure service and application. Your data and network traffic stay secure and private
  inside your data center and behind your firewall.
  
  **Enable AI on your Private Data**
  
  Now you can do AI inferencing and multistep reasoning on your private data while keeping that data
  private.
  
  [Learn more][27]
* ## Fusion Applications
  
  Fusion is the only application suite that brings AI to every aspect of your business:
  
  **ERP Applications**
  
  [Finance and Accounting][28]
  [Supply Chain and Manufacturing][29]
  
  **HCM Applications**

  [Fusion Application Suite]
  
  ### DHL Supply Chain runs on Oracle Fusion

* [Health Application Suite]
  
  ### Digital Ambulance
  
  Patients are continually monitored in transit by hospital ER doctors
  
  ## Health Application Suite
  
  Oracle Health is the first of our Application Suites to be entirely rebuilt as a set of AI Agents
  connected by workflows. The Oracle Health Suite includes applications for managing the entire
  healthcare ecosystem including providers: ambulatory clinics, acute care
  hospitals; payers: insurance companies, governments;  and public health and regulatory agencies.
  
  **Healthcare Applications**
  
  Ambulatory Care System for Clinics
  Acute Care System for Hospitals
  Clinical and Financial Operations
  Payer Preauthorization System
  
  **Healthcare Technology Foundation**
  
  Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
  AI Data Platform
  Oracle AI Database
  
  [Learn more][36]
* ## Industry Specific Applications
  
  Oracle provides industry specific cloud application suites for more than two dozen industries.
  These are modern SaaS applications with built-in AI, machine learning, and analytics. These
  industry applications integrate seamlessly with core business functions in Fusion ERP, HCM, Supply
  Chain, Finance, and Customer Experience. Here are a few examples:
  
  **Banking Suite**
  
  Includes core banking, anti-money laundering, risk management, compliance, and AI analytics.
  
  **Construction and Engineering**
  
  Includes project management, procurement, supplier analytics, subcontractor payments, cost
  controls, and more.
  
  **Retail Suite**
  
  Includes merchandising, multistore inventory management, omnichannel demand forecasting, etc.

#### Revolutionary medicines enable us to enrich and extend life for people living with all types of
#### diseases. 

[Internal medicine graphical thumbnail portrait image 2]

##### [ Internal Medicine ][109]

[ View All Internal Medicine ][110]

We’re developing therapies to treat, slow, or prevent disease progression and improve the quality of
life for patients with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular and kidney diseases. 

[Inflammation and Immunology graphical thumbnail portrait image 3]

##### [ Inflammation & Immunology ][111]

[ View All Inflammation & Immunology ][112]

We look for treatments that provide more than just symptom relief, in order to address the root
cause of chronic inflammatory diseases at a molecular level

[Vaccine graphical thumbnail portrait image 4]

##### [ Vaccines ][113]

[ View All Vaccines ][114]

Vaccines are the single most important innovation in the science of health to significantly reduce
the threat of diseases that were once widespread and oftentimes fatal. 

[Vaccines][115] 
[Milestones][116] 
[Pipeline & Clinical Trials ][117]

lives of cancer patients worldwide.

[Oncology][120]

health outcomes.

# Aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für flüssige Produkte von Rommelag

Als **Erfinder der Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS) Technologie** ist Rommelag Ihr zuverlässiger
One-Stop-Partner für aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für Ihre flüssigen Produkte. Neben unseren
leistungs­starken bottelpack Abfüllanlagen bieten wir Lohnabfüll­dienst­leistungen, Unterstützung bei
der Produkt­entwicklung sowie ein umfassendes Service­angebot für alle Ihre Verpackungs­anforderungen.

One-Stop-Partner für aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für Ihre flüssigen Produkte. Neben unseren

[Rendering einer bottelpack Anlage bp550]

Technologie

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

[BFS entdecken][42]
[bottelpack Anlagen entdecken][43]

cdmo

Ganz gleich, ob Sie die BFS-Technologie ohne großes Investitionsrisiko testen möchten,
Produktionsspitzen abdecken oder Marktchargen vollständig produzieren wollen – unsere
**[Lohnabfüllung][44] **bietet Ihnen modernste Anlagen und ein umfassendes Servicepaket zu äußerst
wettbewerbsfähigen Preisen.

Zudem bietet unser erfahrenes Team umfassende Unterstützung bei der **Entwicklung **und Optimierung
Ihres Produkts für die Blow-Fill-Seal-Technologie.

hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

# Leading Global Pharmaceutical Company

Salvavidas Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is committed to being the world’s leading manufacturer and
exporter of finished dosage forms (FDFs) and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). Our main goal
is to improve patient outcomes while establishing industry-defining standards. We strive to produce
necessary drugs that are affordable, easily available, and effective.

## We are offering
## best Services & Products

High-quality pharmaceutical, ayurvedic, and antibiotic medications are available from Salvavidas
Pharmaceutical, a well-known pharmaceutical manufacturer and supplier in India. Customers can choose
from a variety of packaging solutions for their items, and flexible payment alternatives. They
guarantee on-time delivery and keep their prices competitive. Salvavidas Pharmaceutical puts the
needs of its patients first by improving safety, efficacy, convenience, and compliance while
offering reasonably priced goods that benefit both patients and society as a whole.
* 
  
  We Committed to Quality Products
* 
  
  WHO-GMP & ISO Certified Facilities

## We Committed for a Better Life

### Salvavidas pharma is a leading pharmaceutical manufacturing and export company in India

We place a high priority on customer happiness, which we accomplish by offering high-quality
medicines on schedule and at fair prices. We promise that every product meets the highest caliber
throughout its development, manufacturing, sale, distribution, etc. We are dedicated to establishing
and preserving solid bonds with our clients worldwide. As a result, we are now recognized as a
reliable exporter offering service globally.

## What we bring to you

Salvavidas Pharma is a well-known Indian pharmaceutical exporter that provides a wide variety of
medications to international markets. The organization, which is based in Surat, Gujarat, is one of
the greatest places to find pharmaceutical items. It provides a wide range of products that are
developed to fulfill the requirements of its customers, such as antimalarials, analgesics, and
antibiotics. Salvavidas Pharma, which has a large worldwide presence, focuses on public health as a
driver for social and economic advancement. It is currently one of the leading pharmaceutical firms
in India. 

[Manufacturing and Export Company][Manufacturing and Export Company]

Salvavidas Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. exports to more than 40 nations across five continents: Africa,
South-East Asia, Latin America, North America, and the CIS region. We are an Indian manufacturer and
exporter of all pharmaceutical items with more than 500 product registrations worldwide.

The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,
marked a pivotal moment for the biotechnology industry. With nearly 20,000 attendees from over 76
countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by
record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5

70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

Aqvesme’s FDA Milestone: Expanding Mitapivat’s Reach in Thalassemia Treatment
][9]
22 January 2026
The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

[
The $4B Patent Cliff: Navigating the Generic Surge as Astellas’ Xtandi Nears Expiration
][13]
22 January 2026
Astellas Pharma is facing a defining moment as its blockbuster prostate cancer therapy, Xtandi
(enzalutamide), approaches a massive patent cliff in 2026 and 2027. With billions in annual revenue
at risk, the pharmaceutical giant is pivoting toward aggressive lifecycle management and strategic
BD (Business Development) to offset the impending generic competition. For generic manufacturers and
oncology innovators, this transition creates a high-stakes environment where the ability to rapidly
deconstruct original patent claims and identify "late-stage" IP vulnerabilities is the key to
capturing market share in a post-Xtandi era.

### [2026 BIO International Convention In-Depth Analysis Report][17]

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,
marked a pivotal moment for the biotechnology industry. With nearly 20,000 attendees from over 76
countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by
record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

Environmental, Social, and Governance

## We Create Lasting Solutions
## That Drive Change

Our ESG commitment shapes how we develop, manufacture, and deliver active pharmaceutical ingredients
(APIs) and CDMO services, with a long-term view toward shared value and global well-being.

[Learn More][112]
Environmental

### Sustainable Practices for a Greener Future

We are committed to minimizing our environmental footprint by integrating eco-conscious practices
into our production and supply chain. From investing in energy-efficient technologies to reducing
water usage and chemical waste, we actively pursue greener processes without compromising quality or
compliance.

Governance

### Integrity and Accountability in Action

We maintain rigorous compliance standards, transparent reporting, and ethical business practices
across our global operations. From quality control to cybersecurity, our governance framework
ensures accountability and risk management at every level.

Social

### Empowering Communities and People Wordwide

People are at the heart of everything we do, and we collaborate with our partners and communities to
promote health, education, and opportunity. Ethical labor practices, ongoing workforce development,
and a commitment to health equity are key pillars of our social impact strategy.

## We Create Lasting Solutions
## That Drive Change

Our ESG commitment shapes how we develop, manufacture, and deliver active pharmaceutical ingredients
(APIs) and CDMO services, with a long-term view toward shared value and global well-being.

[Learn More][112]
Environmental

### Sustainable Practices for a Greener Future

We are committed to minimizing our environmental footprint by integrating eco-conscious practices
into our production and supply chain. From investing in energy-efficient technologies to reducing
water usage and chemical waste, we actively pursue greener processes without compromising quality or
compliance.

Governance

### Integrity and Accountability in Action

We maintain rigorous compliance standards, transparent reporting, and ethical business practices
across our global operations. From quality control to cybersecurity, our governance framework
ensures accountability and risk management at every level.

Social

### Empowering Communities and People Wordwide

People are at the heart of everything we do, and we collaborate with our partners and communities to
promote health, education, and opportunity. Ethical labor practices, ongoing workforce development,
and a commitment to health equity are key pillars of our social impact strategy.

* 1970
  
  We introduced the most popular two-piece hard gelatin capsule in the world - Capsugel® Coni-Snap®
  Hard Gelatin Capsule. This technology is a patented, two-ring closure system facilitating
  high-speed filling processing and secure locking of capsule body and cap.
* 1985
  
  Our portfolio of premium grade L-carnitine ingredients began with the launch of Carnipure®
  L-carnitine crystalline, which accelerated research and development behind the important benefits
  of L-carnitine for human and animal health.
* 1986
  
  ChromeMate® niacin-bound chromium complex was launched, offering nutraceutical brands an
  opportunity to create science-backed solutions that help to maintain healthy cholesterol levels
  and support weight management.

  Carnipure® L-carnitine tartrate was introduced into the nutraceutical market and the first human
  clinical trials were initiated, leading to groundbreaking new insights behind the role of
  L-carnitine in supporting exercise recovery.
* 1993
  
  Our journey exploring science-backed solutions to meet the needs of the pet and production animal
  markets began with the launch of Carniking® L-carnitine for pet health.
* 1997
  
  Super CitriMax® 60% HCA was launched into the nutraceutical market, offering brands a unique
  solution for satiety and appetite.

  We transformed the pharmaceutical industry with the introduction of our DBCaps® over-encapsulation
  capsules. This is a double-blind solution with a tamper-evident design, addressing the clinical
  trial challenge of testing without bias.

  revolutionary capsule sealing and fusion technology. This technology is specifically designed to
  encapsulate liquid-based and specialty powder formulations.

  offering superior absorption, retention and antioxidant properties over other forms of zinc.

  UC-II® undenatured type II collagen was launched, marking the beginning of its successful journey
  as a unique joint health ingredient, available for clinical trial investigation.
* 2008
  
  ResistAid® arabinogalactan was launched, making the unique immune health benefits of this
  ingredient available to brands in the nutraceutical market.

  The gold standard in HPMC capsules was introduced — Capsugel® Vcaps® Plus HPMC capsules. This
  capsule is produced by specifically developed thermo-gelation processes, without the addition of
  gelling systems.

  probiotics against stomach acid and release them at the right time and in the right location in
  the body, this capsule polymer allows brands to create more advanced products that target diverse
  health areas.
  
  We transformed the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical market through Plantcaps® pullulan capsules—a
  plant-based vegetarian alternative. This groundbreaking solution enables brands to meet the
  preferences of environmentally-conscious consumers and patients.

  We streamlined the capsule manufacturing filling process with the launch of Ultra III®, a
  high-speed, semi-automatic filling machine, providing drug developers with an innovative and
  flexible solution to meet a wide array of filling requirements.

  The first customer commercialized our proprietary lipid multi-particulate technology,
  strengthening our positioning as an industry-leading partner in the nutraceutical and
  pharmaceutical markets.

  We purchased Capsugel and InterHealth to create a leading integrated solutions provider to the
  global pharma and consumer healthcare industries.

  is suitable for vegan and vegetarian diets, as well as being allergen and gluten-free.

  leading equipment manufacturers, where we offer reliable powder-filling equipment, plus
  world-class service and support capabilities.

## Solutions that power progress

From AI and cloud to cybersecurity, digital workplace and enterprise computing solutions, we deliver

### AI that drives human innovation

Turn AI investments into business results. Unisys combines strategic AI advisory, solution
development, and scalable infrastructure with the change management expertise you need to succeed.
We help you put AI to work where it matters most, positioning you to compete and grow with
confidence.

Get more from your cloud investments. Unisys cloud solutions simplify migration, modernization and
cloud management across cloud hosts like AWS, Azure, Google, and your data center. Intelligent
automation simplifies complexity while keeping costs predictable and performance strong.

[
Learn more
][140]

Thrive in a digital-first world by modernizing existing applications, embedding AI-driven
intelligence and automation, and securely developing new ones that prioritize user experience.

are scalable, intuitive, and cost-effective. Run your business with applications tailored to you.

later if needed.

###### Can I keep using WhatsApp on my phone and WhatsApp Web after connecting the API?

Yes. The API works through a linked-device session, so you can keep using WhatsApp on your phone and
in WhatsApp Web in parallel. To keep the session active, it is usually enough to use WhatsApp on
your phone at least once every 14 days. In some cases, WhatsApp may still reset linked sessions and
require re-authorization.

## Driven by a passion for innovation, making a difference in the world of health and care

[Innovation Excellence][14]
[Zydus Srishti]

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
